text: I just want a night out. Two seats together, and dinner before the film.
Both websites work. But tiny controls and a busy screen don't work for everyone.
Maybe you have an accessibility need. Maybe clutter makes it hard to focus. Or you simply like things a different way.
So I ask: bigger buttons, fewer distractions, two seats together. With As I Am, the website adapts to how I want to use it.
Same cinema. Same seats. Just easier to use. I can check the original anytime. And I still choose, review the price, and confirm myself.
Now, dinner. Here's the full restaurant again: the details, all those times. I don't want to set everything up twice.
I choose to bring my preferences here. Bigger controls. Clearer steps. The restaurant keeps its own design, and my table choice. My cinema booking and personal reasons stay out.
Web M C P makes this possible. The website tells an agent what it can change. The agent asks. The site adapts and checks the result. These guided buttons replay those requests.
This goes beyond tickets. Bigger text, easier tapping, less to take in. Shopping, travel, everyday forms: the same idea, wherever websites support it.

chapter: Your needs. Your preferences. Your web.
text: A web that adapts to what you like, and what you need. As I Am. The web adapts to you.
